sections.content: You know *quizás* and *es posible que* + subjunctive from B1 Unit 13. New here: *puede que* and *tal vez*, and the adverbs *probablemente* and *posiblemente*, which show different degrees of certainty. *Quizá*, *tal vez*, *es posible que* and *puede que* take the subjunctive when you are not sure; with *posiblemente* the future is also normal: *Posiblemente habrá más cambios.*

items.spanish: Posiblemente habrá más cambios el próximo año.
items.english: There will possibly be more changes next year.

items.spanish: Es posible que el resultado sea diferente.
items.english: It is possible that the result will be different.

sections.content: Probability expressions allow you to avoid presenting a prediction as certain.
